title: Rime, which helps companies field calls using AI voice models trained on conversational data it records in a studio, raised a $24M Series A led by M13 (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Rime, which helps companies field calls using AI voice models trained on conversational data it records in a studio, raised a $24M Series A led by M13 — Voice AI startups' biggest unlock has been handling calls for enterprises in areas like sales, marketing and customer support.
